verdict.rationale: Jitsu explicitly documents a public Management API with full OpenAPI 3.0 reference covering workspaces, sites, destinations, connections, syncs, and functions, plus a jitsu-cli described as 'a real command-line interface that does everything the UI does,' and an MCP server letting AI agents manage the pipeline directly (create destinations, wire streams, edit functions).
